note: Corpus and thresholds fixed BEFORE the official measurement. Any change to this file after the first push that contains it invalidates the run and requires a new prereg commit.
platform: x86_64 Linux; userspace simulation of uprobe breakpoints (box has unprivileged_bpf_disabled=2)
detector: byte-for-byte compare of PT_LOAD RX mapping of the running binary against the corresponding bytes of /proc/self/exe (ELF file). Any mismatch is a detection.

canary.int3_plant: mprotect page RWX; write 0xCC over the first byte of the canary; scan; restore
canary.branch_only_plant: mprotect page RWX; flip the canary je/jne (0x74↔0x75), no int3; scan; restore

by_construction_caveat: 100% TPR and 0% FPR are on a corpus written by the same author as the detector: three synthetic arms (clean / int3 / branch flip) against the detector's own canary. Not a blind evaluation against real eBPF uprobes.
out_of_scope_until_measured: real kernel uprobe attach (optional enforce job; must fail loudly if unavailable)
